content_html: Have you thought about switching to Elevate? I’m one of their reps, and I know firsthand that their VOIP service is far better than Vonage; it uses the highest tier for digital quality. Vonage uses low tier, and spends most of its money on advertising. On top of that, Elevate customer service is spot on. You will have the personal phone number of the rep that signs you up, and they will answer your questions and provide you service personally; no more fighting with answering machines! We also do Satellite TV through Dish, High-Speed DSL, and wireless home security through ADT. Drop me a note on my myspace if you’re interested; I’ll be your rep! http://www.goelevate.com if you want to check them out. My rep code is MB805.
